caption: The drawing depicts three metal fireplace tools standing upright in front of a plain light-colored background with decorative vertical lines, forming a simple frame. From left to right, the first object is a pair of tongs with curved handles at the top, narrow straight shafts, and rounded gripping ends; the handles and upper section feature a gold-toned decorative finial with a bulbous shape. In the center, a close-up view shows the ornate finial detail in gold and dark gray, emphasizing the intricate turnings and contrasting highlights. The object on the right is a shovel, with a long, slightly bent handle topped by a similar gold and gray decorative finial, and a broad, flattened scoop that is shown with blue-gray shading to indicate its metallic surface, some wear, and three-dimensional form. A small ruler indicating inches is drawn in the lower left corner, and the artist’s signature, "Hans Korsch," appears in the lower right. The drawing employs muted tones of gold, gray, and black for the objects, and uses fine lines and shading to provide texture and depth.
title: Fire Tongs, Shovel, and Jamb Hooks
